facts.statement: Jiaodontus is an extinct genus of cartilaginous fish belonging to the family Lonchidiidae.
facts.quote: Jiaodontus is an extinct genus of lonchidiid cartilaginous fish

facts.statement: The genus was first described by Klug, Tütken, Wings, Pfretzschner, and Martin in 2010.
facts.quote: It was first named by Stefanie Klug, Thomas Tütken, Oliver Wings, Hans-Ulrich Pfretzschner and Thomas Martin in 2010

facts.statement: Jiaodontus lived during the Oxfordian age of the Late Jurassic in northwestern China.
facts.quote: which existed in Liuhuanggou, Xinjiang Uyghur Autonomous Region, northwestern China, during the late Jurassic (Oxfordian age)

facts.statement: Fossils of Jiaodontus have been discovered in the Qigu Formation in China.
facts.quote: Fossils have been found in the Qigu Formation, China

facts.statement: Jiaodontus is classified within the class Chondrichthyes.
The type species of the genus Jiaodontus is J. montaltissimus.
The genus includes the type species J. montaltissimus and the species J. vedenemus, both described in 2010.
facts.quote: J. montaltissimus Klug et al., 2010 (type) J. vedenemus Klug et al., 2010
